description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the RemoveImageSubtitles operation in the imageenhan category
description_zh: 本文介绍图像生产（imageenhan）类目下的字幕擦除RemoveImageSubtitles的语法及示例
name: RemoveImageSubtitles

parameters.help_en:
The image URL. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket in another region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

The URL cannot contain Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

URL地址中不能包含中文字符
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The ratio of the x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the subtitle area to the image width. Valid values: 0 to 1
parameters.help_zh: 字幕区域的左上角点x坐标相对图像宽度的占比值，取值范围0~1
parameters.name: bx

parameters.help_en: The ratio of the y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the subtitle area to the image height. Valid values: 0 to 1
parameters.help_zh: 字幕区域的左上角点y坐标相对图像高度的占比值，取值范围0~1
parameters.name: by

parameters.help_en: The ratio of the width of the subtitle area to the image width. Valid values: 0 to 1
parameters.help_zh: 字幕区域的宽度相对图像宽度的占比值，取值范围0~1
parameters.name: bw

parameters.help_en: The ratio of the height of the subtitle area to the image height. Valid values: 0 to 1
parameters.help_zh: 字幕区域的高度相对图像高度的占比值，取值范围0~1
parameters.name: bh

ImageURL.description_en:
The URL of the output image with subtitles removed.
The URL is a temporary URL and is valid for 30 minutes. It becomes inaccessible after it expires. To retain the file for a long time or permanently, access the URL and download the file to your OSS bucket or other storage space within 30 minutes
ImageURL.description_zh:
输出擦除字幕后的图像URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间
